backup.restore_point: PENDING: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill this with its folder (fill-restore-point.mjs)
backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable. A second run stops on its own md5 guard by design (the three bodies are no longer the ones it was cut from); to undo, apply the rollback. Apply AFTER s81_notices_20261014, s81_staff_pay_push_20261014 and s82_staff_31_20261015: the first block stops (55000, nothing changed) unless staff_push_subscribe_v1(text,text,text,text) is exactly fbda406e0b4e4d80854ce1c383615080, ops_notice_add_v1 is ee6211cfc99aa9735ea2f0f588f38e79 and s_weekly_sweep_v1 is a6082c2fca6d6f2cd136ce9057a1fc99 (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped). Additive except three function bodies: (1) staff_push_subscriptions.topics text[] not null default '{paid,notices}' with a CHECK (1 to 3 entries, only paid, notices and inbox): every existing phone is filled with the default; (2) staff_push_subscribe_v1 gains an optional p_topics text[]: the 4-argument function is DROPPED and replaced by the 5-argument one (one overload, so a 4-key RPC call from the live Staff app still resolves); with p_topics null it behaves exactly as before and answers {ok:true}; with topics it merges them into the phone's row (asking for one never removes the other), keeps inbox only for an active owner/admin, and answers {ok:true, topics:[...]}; (3) staff_push_unsubscribe_topic_v1(endpoint, topic) removes one topic from the caller's own phone and deletes the row with the last one; (4) staff_push_inbox_recipients_v1() (service role only): the phones that hold inbox, for people who are an active owner/admin right now; (5) table staff_push_claims (RLS on, no API-role grant) and staff_push_claim_v1(key) (service role only): true once per key; s_weekly_sweep_v1 now also deletes claims older than 7 days (everything else in it is byte-identical); (7) XS2 (Lloyd 2026-10-14, notifications on by default): a third topic notices for every active staff role. The column default is {paid,notices} and the ADD COLUMN fills every existing phone with it, so every phone already registered will hear about a scheduled brownout or water interruption and about rain at the house; staff_push_subscribe_v1 with p_topics null gives a NEW phone the same default (a phone that moves to another person is reset to it); staff_push_notice_recipients_v1(property) (service role only) lists the phones holding notices for people who are active staff of that property now; the trigger ops_notices_push (AFTER INSERT on a brownout or water notice of the Cascade property only) asks notify-staff-inbox through pg_net and the vault secret cascade_cron_shared_secret, guarded like the paid trigger (nothing happens where either is absent), and never blocks the insert; (6) ops_notice_add_v1 accepts type brownout (source stays manual; the CHECK lists already allow both; notices_v1 already returns brownout rows as type power). No existing row is changed, no secret is added.
backup.notes: Deploy order, exactly: (1) this SQL (after a fresh backup); (2) the Edge Functions notify-cleaner-payment (it now sends the paid notice only to phones holding the paid topic and falls back to the old read while the column is absent), notify-staff-inbox with verify_jwt OFF (supabase functions deploy notify-staff-inbox --no-verify-jwt; kinds handover, guest_wrote, notice, rain), rain-alert (adds the staff push for rain within 3 hours; the Telegram warning is unchanged) and messenger-concierge. Secrets by name, all existing: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPID_SUBJECT, CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET, GOOGLE_WEATHER_API_KEY; the vault secret cascade_cron_shared_secret must exist (the trigger reads it). Before step 2 the trigger's call 404s inside pg_net and is ignored; before the SQL the new functions answer rpc_failed and send nothing. Until the Staff app is used, phones registered before the apply already hold notices and paid; a phone registered by the live 3.1.1 app after the apply gets {paid,notices} too. Rollback of the SQL needs the functions left as they are: with the RPCs gone the senders answer rpc_failed and send nothing.

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores the three function bodies to the exact bodies this release was cut from (md5-checked) and drops what it added. Lost: the topics column (a phone that held only the inbox topic is deleted, so it does not start hearing about payments) and at most 7 days of staff_push_claims keys. Brownouts typed by hand stay and keep showing in notices_v1; a new one can no longer be added (type_not_allowed), as before the release.
